threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the ‘Overground’ instead of just the ‘Gooner Train’ when talking to locals. Definitely a newcomer mistake.
Last night on the 35, a guy on crutches tried to steal a seat from a sleeping tourist. The tourist woke up confused, just saw the crutches.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a wedding party parading down the street with a vintage Trabant, music blaring, and everyone dancing was when I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a karaoke bar in an old U-Bahn tunnel – it’s got the best acoustics and a vibe like no other.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know the hidden corners of Dolores Park and avoid the BART fiasco like a pro, especially after a late match.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Heard a guy on the 14 Mission just casually explain the concept of 'transit equity' to a tourist. Only in SF would that kind of conversation happen on a bus.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just quiet streets and plazas, but they miss the pulse of locals in late-night bars, where the real stories get shared.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the maps they constantly whip out, trying to navigate the ever-changing bus routes like it's their first day.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'shop' instead of a 'corner shop' when you pop down for a pint of milk. The locals know better.
Caught the N199 last night—two blokes arguing over a half-eaten kebab. One insisted it was 'a culinary masterpiece'. Only in Bromley, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: It hit me when I saw a guy skateboarding past a woman feeding pigeons, while a street musician belted out 'Wonderwall' on the corner. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a hidden rooftop garden bar tucked between old buildings, where locals sip cocktails while the trains rumble by below.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local if they know which BART stops avoid during game nights — and can spot the tourists still confused by ticket machines.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last night, I saw a guy on the 31 Balboa serenading everyone with a ukulele. Muni delays turned into a mini concert. Only in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists miss how we actually use the same streets for fiestas that we navigate every day. They think it's all just for show, but it’s part of our life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they stare at the metro map like it's a treasure map, looking for something that doesn't exist.
